STATE OF CALIFORNIA - HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT (HCD)
Date: December 8, 2021
To: City of Anaheim, Mayor Harry Sidhu
Notice of Violation under Cal. Gov. Code § 54220 (Surplus Land Act).
The proposed $320,000,000 stadium land disposition violates statutory affordable housing rules.
Assessing a 30% statutory penalty of $96,000,000.00.
